dome.consequence: Indoors — no weather impact on passing.

calm.consequence: Normal conditions — no weather impact on passing.

moderate.consequence: Moderate wind (11–20 mph): minimal impact; deep routes may be affected.

high.consequence: High wind (21–30 mph): passing efficiency is ~36% reduced. Expect more short-to-intermediate routes and potential run-game emphasis.

severe.consequence: Severe wind (31+ mph): extreme weather. Passing game is heavily compromised — ground game and field position dominate.
